book.name: Apasoro
book.title: APASORO NAU MUMAWA Siosi Amatonewa Gaiyawa

content: Poru Wa Gumbe Romu Aitan Aivi
Gare mu yaug anoyawa, nu wa gumbe Itari angetan ete. Poru ge nog igiyawa upeba mu senturion iviwa Jurias nanive teya. Me Romu kokavitwa mut igiyawa meuma danave wakenewa.
Nu Adramaitium wa meuma danave dauwag kweg antu. Wa mame at toimu ampa ampa Esia danave unig dauwag aitan aiviwa. At Tesaronika danave Masedonia apan Aristarukas me nu gaibu.
Oiyat umae at Saidon uniktu. Jurias baigan gumbe Poru amaraivi, sira ung wane Poru me owawaiwa oya aipe baigan gumbe ape.
Me apa nu dauwag antu, megara taig gud nunnewa, Saipras megiyave antu.
Sira Sirisia ge Pampiria poeman danave antune, sira at Maira toimu Rusia danave uniktu.
Asimeve Arekisandria wa meuma me Itari aitan aiviwa wakene, senturion
me yaune, sira wane nu wa asime dauwatu.

Kum upeba danave wa ekekenut aivine. Sira nu at Kunidas poeman meuma yusiyusi ag uwatune. Megara taig koka anewa nu oma den ane sira angetan, meoya nu at Kurete me poeman Sarumone apa wakenewa visive antu.
Poeman visive angete, yusiyusi ag angek at iviwa waya wa yoiviwa arawa oraiwa uniktu. At me megiyave, at Rasea gwetoimu wakene.
Kum koka waropiyatu, sira kwit kumiwa wait onanane, meoya wa gumbe angetanwa me kukaeba, Poru dirum wane,
“Iyayapan neuma, ne anoeniwa a numawa mame danave kukaeba pawatan aivi, tawara ge wa mame mukut onan inaiinai numawa gaibu kukaeba uwanuntan aivi.”
Megara senturion me wa yumnasiviwa abnawa ge wa mamawa anotumat yusipamit ane. Poru wanewa me anotumat yusipamit den ane.

Sira wa yoiviwa arawa mame me bainda onan taig kumiwa danave waketanwa oya, meoya iyayapan dadi wayawa maib, mame kweta, sira oma ape ipewa Kurete danave wa yoivi arawa Penikus anta—me sausuwest ge noosuwest gumbe wakenewa anta, sira taig kumiwa at me apa waketa.
Taig Koka Uwane
Sira taig memeyaivinewa sausu apa uwanewa, iyayapan kum mame di apa wa anika
ororiyaya dauwane, at Kurete ginayapawa visive angete.
Megara kum koni yobe onan, taig koka iviwa Yurokraidon
me tui ge pawawa apa aig onne.
Wa taig yumnadnewa, oma den ane wa aine taig manne. Meoya wa kwetune ingan aivi.
Megara wa me ginayapawa kusi iviwa Kauda megiyave aivi, meoya nu oma ane yusiyusi ag wa kusi yumnattu.

Nu wa kusi enagattu wa kokawa danave barautu, sira murap me wait tamibarip ayawa gumbe tutune. Sira wa me at Sirutes togewa apa aitan aivine nu a atune, meoya nu wa anika meuma barautu poeman danave aigne wa inganit aivine.
Taig koka gumbe aig ge dauwa antune, sira oiyat umae iyayapan amatog tawara upeba wa danave wakeyawa emetune.
Oiyat duwamdesi apa, nu nanuwo wa dividivi meumawa upeba tam epa emeya.
Nu oma den ane kum ge marantun yawamtu, oiyat upeba onanane, taig koka ande toivinewa, oieba nu gob waitawaita oya anog yankwetu.

Bira da kum obiren nakwai da den naya, meoya Poru namuwo yoig dirum wane, “Iyayapan neuma, ne gae neuma aug wa gumbe at Kurete ginayapawa apa den onantuwa, nu kukaeba mame ge waropiyatanwa den gaveyapono.
Megara gare mame di ne wasiwam yeneni. Yusiyusi aya. Ye daneyap undag da bira inaiinai den waropiyape. Wa mekut waropiyata.
Watau arampuna, God nauwawa eniwa aneyaeba namunap yoine,
me wane, ‘Poru, den a a. Ge Siisa namive yoitanit di. Sira God me iyayapan undag mu wa danave ge gaibu wakeyawa genna.’
Meoya iyayapan neuma, yusiyusi aya. Ne God gumbe anotumat eniwa, dividivi undag me matai veniyape wait ne didnednewa mina.
Nu matai ampa ginayapawa visive angetanit di.”
Wa Koka Kukaine
Oiyat 14 onanane, aram sisipuna danave, nu poeman Adria apa aig ge dauwa etewa, aram nub bagiwa apa wa nau eme igiyawa anoyawa, wa me piyu da uwatan aivi.
Mu poeman epampa meuma aninin om wariyawa, mu yaug anoya epampa meumawa 40 mitas mina. Sira utunut siririyaya sira om wariyawa me 30 mitas mina.
Mu anogugut ayawa me an koka poeman danave dauwapetan, meoya wa anika duwam ge duwam wa virive apa emiya sira wantetan oya amareme.
Megara wa nau eme igiyawa wa gumbe a amotan eme, sira mu ugauga ake wa anika aoretan oya eme, wa kusi barauya poeman egave ekekenut aigivi.
Meoya Poru me senturion ge mut igiyawa dirum wane, “Wa danave iyayapan mame den wakepe ipewa, ye gaibu waitawaita den auya.”
Meve mut igiyawa wa kusi murap meuma togomiyaya kweya ingan aine.
Wanteivi omome, Poru wasiwam munne undag nakwai natan oya, “Ye amarene amarene, onne gare nakwai da den nayana, oiyat 14 onanane.
Meoya ne ye diruiyeni nakwai naya. Mame ye sira yutuiwa yempe oya. Kuiyegumewa danave desirom da den waropiyape.”
Meib wane, sira bredi aune iyayapan undag namuwo God gumbe gaun wane, sira warensig amatog nane.
Meve iyayapan yutuwa auya, sira amatog nakwai naya.
Nu wa danave waketuwa undag 276.
Undag nakwai kokavit naya oma ane, meve wa beumatan oya mu nakwai wiit emeya poeman danave aigeya.
Wantenewa, mu at piyu ginangawa yaiyai den yaug anoya, megara mu awau eg baraune yauyawa, mu imuwo awau uniktan anoya.
Wa anika murapeba togomiyaya poeman danave aigne, me koniwa apa murap barauk tuyawa vesiya, sira wa wapeyawa taig autan oya wan yuya dauwane, sira awau noiwa oya amome.

Sira togewa me apa yoi poeman danave kintoiviwa duwam uwagaveya eme, meoya wa togewa apa yabnadne. Wa kuiyawa yabnadne aitanwa oma den ane, sira yawarat yusipamitwa wa viriwa yabnewa, me amatog dumedne.
Mut igiyawa garawano ayawa mu nog igiyawa undag gutpe boriruwape, kuiyawa nog igiyawa oi tek a ampewa me bainda onan me kukaine.

Megara senturion anoiviwa me Poru waita wantan. Meoya me mu anoemewa topayane. Me dirum wanewa namu birabira oma ane oi teemewa pisiag aigiya poeman danave sira piyu egave dauwape, ivi iyayapan upeba yoma peyawa ge wa peyawa upeba yumnat oeteg ampe. Meib aya, sira iyayapan undag piyu egave yaiyai dauwaya.

footnotes.text: Me marakibubu mina. Wa yokenewa marakibubu minawa yoi dana aoreeme. Wa aitanwa oya me ororieme dauwaivi.
Me taig koka nosuiist apa oniviwa.
